state_profile.voting_summary: Tennessee votes early: two weeks of no-excuse early in-person voting carried about 40% of the 2024 vote (plus a large totals-only share), with mail excuse-required at 2%. Polls close at 8 p.m. Eastern; early and absentee votes are released first in large county batches, then election day precincts report, with the state near-complete by midnight. Early voting ran R+13 against R+24 on election day, so the first batches modestly understate the final Republican margin.
